abstract: Polypropylene-infused (PP) Novel Ni–SiC–TiO2 (First time reported ) nano-engineered composite Superhydrophobic (SH) coatings were fabricated on surgical stainless steel via electro-assisted co-deposition to obtain superhydrophobic and corrosion-resistant surfaces for biomedical applications. title: Corrosion of Candidate Cladding and Structural Materials for Sodium-Cooled Fast Reactor Applications
abstract: Generation IV reactors aim for more efficient, cheaper, safer nuclear power with less waste generation. Sodium-cooled fast reactors (SFRs) are expected to be among the first GenIV designs to operate. SFR structural and cladding materials must withstand high‐temperature liquid <mark>sodium</mark>, where degradation is driven by selective dissolution and impurity‐mediated reactions rather than electrochemistry. abstract: Eutectic solvents are emerging as sustainable alternatives to traditional organic solvents, offering tunable properties and a lower environmental footprint.
